metadata.question: Did the visible water extent in the North Crimean Canal in Ukraine decrease between June 3 and July 19, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare water extent in the North Crimean Canal between two specific dates: June 3, 2023 and July 19, 2023 - Use Sentinel-2 for high-resolution water detection (10m bands) - Location: North Crimean Canal, Ukraine (approximately 45.5°N, 33.5°E to 46°N, 34.5°E) - Use narrow date ranges around each specific date to get cloud-free images 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds using QA60 band (Sentinel-2 cloud mask) - Use water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) to detect water extent - MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) works well for water detection 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid Zero (Answer B): Water extent calculation succeeds, showing June 3 >= July 19 (no decrease or increase) - Decrease (Answer A): Water extent on July 19 < June 3 - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define the North Crimean Canal area in Ukraine const canalRegion = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[33.5, 45.5], [34.5, 45.5], [34.5, 46.2], [33.5, 46.2], [33.5, 45.5]] ]); // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Function to calculate water extent using MNDWI function calculateWaterExtent(startDate, endDate, label) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(canalRegion) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskS2clouds); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${label} - Images found: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { return null; } const image = collection.median(); // Calculate MNDWI: (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); // Water is typically MNDWI > 0 const waterMask = mndwi.gt(0); // Count valid pixels const pixelCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canalRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`${label} - Valid pixels after masking: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { return { pixels: 0, waterExtent: 0 }; } // Calculate water extent (sum of water pixels) const waterExtent = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: canalRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI').getInfo(); return { pixels: pixelCount, waterExtent: waterExtent }; } // 4. Calculate water extent for both dates const june3 = calculateWaterExtent('2023-06-01', '2023-06-05', 'June 3'); if (june3 === null) { console.log('No images found for June 3, 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (june3.pixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for June 3 after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } const july19 = calculateWaterExtent('2023-07-17', '2023-07-21', 'July 19'); if (july19 === null) { console.log('No images found for July 19, 2023'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (july19.pixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for July 19 after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Validate and compare if (june3.waterExtent === null || july19.waterExtent === null || isNaN(june3.waterExtent) || isNaN(july19.waterExtent)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`June 3 water extent: ${june3.waterExtent.toFixed(0)} pixels`); console.log(`July 19 water extent: ${july19.waterExtent.toFixed(0)} pixels`); const decrease = july19.waterExtent < june3.waterExtent; const percentChange = ((july19.waterExtent - june3.waterExtent) / june3.waterExtent * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (decrease) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
